item.title: Every AI Subscription on One Screen: an Open-Source Tool That Even Counts the Skills You Never Called
item.description: AIUsage 0.16 shipped on Nov 2: 12 kinds of provider quotas on one menu-bar screen, four coding proxies plus an account-pool gateway, and session search with one-click resume. Summary version; full discussion at the BBS link below.

item.title: WSL 3 Ships: A Native Linux Container Engine on Windows, 2x Cross-System File Speed
item.description: On September 29, Microsoft moved WSL 3.0.1 to GA, landing the wslc container CLI, the Consomme network mode, and virtiofs file acceleration in one shot. I installed it on Windows 11 and walked through the architecture, networking, and honest limits.
